ideas.title: Minnesota Officials Embroiled in Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of fraud against Minnesota officials and the ongoing DOJ probe.
ideas.angle: In-depth look at the investigation and potential implications for Minnesota
questions: What are the specific allegations against Minnesota officials?
How will the DOJ probe impact the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant financial irregularities and corruption within Minnesota's government. It's essential to follow the money trail and identify key figures involved.

ideas.title: The Impact of ICE Protests on Minnesota Communities
ideas.description: This story would explore the effects of ICE protests on local communities in Minnesota and the broader implications for immigration enforcement.
ideas.angle: Human interest perspective on the protests and their impact
questions: How are ICE protests affecting local businesses and residents?
What are the concerns of community leaders?
ideas.insight: This story can provide a nuanced understanding of the tensions between ICE and local communities in Minnesota. It's crucial to gather data and quotes from various stakeholders.
